decisions.reason: Cites LinkType Junction, Target E:\dev\dsh-attach-input and the link: marker, explains repo edits already change the installed copy, calls copy-through-junction never appropriate, and distinguishes a copied dependency installation.

Ties copy-session.txt to host-owned handles, states closing the tab does not stop the host, separately explains browser HTTP cache, and explicitly limits itself against extrapolating this host's serving behavior.

Explains renaming through the junction renamed the sole source files making the copy fail, restores .old2 names via Rename-Item preserving contents, runs node --check on both, and stops the host first as a precaution without requiring locked renames or recreation.

Gives the semantic dependency order: fully stop host, start fresh dsh web, cache-bypassing hard refresh, then verify served code, feature, route and absence of errors; states browser restart alone is insufficient and syntax check is not activation.

Pre-flight inspects LinkType/Target on both paths and the cordis.patch.yml marker, chooses linked vs copied procedure, and explains generic copy-into-node_modules advice as actively harmful cause of the incident.

caps.reason: Final plan only renames .old2 back via the repo path and explicitly forbids copying, deleting .old2 content, or treating the paths as independent.
Plan requires fully stopping and restarting the dsh host before cache-bypassing refresh; explicitly says closing/reopening a tab is not the host step.
